name: @pipeworx/mcp-abuseipdb

tools.name: check_ip
tools.description: Check an IP address against the AbuseIPDB database. Returns abuse confidence score (0-100), ISP, usage type, country, number of reports, and last reported date. Example: check_ip("8.8.8.8").

ip.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address to check (e.g., "118.25.6.39")

tools.name: report_ip
tools.description: Report an abusive IP address to AbuseIPDB. Requires category IDs (e.g., "18,22" for DDoS + SSH brute force). Returns the updated abuse confidence score.

ip.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address to report (e.g., "118.25.6.39")

categories.description: Comma-separated category IDs (e.g., "18,22"). Common: 3=Fraud, 4=DDoS, 14=Port Scan, 18=Brute Force, 22=SSH, 23=Telnet

comment.description: Description of the abuse (e.g., "SSH brute force attack from this IP")

tools.name: get_blacklist
tools.description: Get the AbuseIPDB blacklist of the most-reported IP addresses. Returns IPs with their abuse confidence scores. Useful for building blocklists.

limit.description: Number of IPs to return (default 100, max 10000)

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-abuseipdb forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the abuseipdb pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
